U.S. River Sediment Transport Is Becoming “Burstier”

The time frame in which U.S. rivers move most of their sediment has compressed significantly, which could have implications for water treatment, aquatic habitats, erosion, and harmful algal blooms.
by Emily Gardner 30 October 202630 October 2026
